name: Ephron
bio: Ephron, son of Zohar the Hittite, lived at Machpelah. After Sarah's death, Abraham purchased the cave of Machpelah from him as a family burial site. Ephron initially offered to give Abraham the field and cave outright, but Abraham insisted on paying full price, finally buying the land for four hundred shekels of silver (Genesis 23). The cave of Machpelah later became the family burial place of Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Rebekah, Jacob, and Leah.
